Read stdin, count words, print top 10.

```python
import sys
from collections import Counter
import re

words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z']+", sys.stdin.read().lower())
for word, n in Counter(words).most_common(10):
    print(f"{n:>6}  {word}")
```
